Simple 4-Step Process

You know your business.
We make the code easy to review.

You don't have to read old programming languages to verify how your software works. A2B Labs translates legacy code into everyday business rules so your whole team can decide what comes next.

Step 1

Add your code & business policy

Start with one of our ready-to-try examples, or drag and drop your own code files alongside the rules they are supposed to follow. AI summarizes what the code currently does and highlights any mismatches.

Step 2

Keep, edit, or drop each rule

Every rule is shown in plain, everyday English. Keep the rules that still make sense, rewrite any rule you want to update, drop outdated logic, or add a brand-new rule before any replacement code is written.

Step 3

Compare & test the updated code

See the original code and the updated code side by side with a plain-English explanation, then run real-world test scenarios in an isolated test environment to verify expected vs. actual results.

Step 4

See estimated time & cost saved

Once your updated code has been generated and tested, Step 4 unlocks an illustrative estimate of team hours and budget saved—with transparent math and adjustable assumptions.
